title: Microsoft 365 admin center: rules that automate agent lifecycle management
summary: Hold: two control rows link to an admin guide that now redirects to a page without their navigation instructions. Replace the user-access route and publish-request instructions with the current dedicated references; the lifecycle rules and licensing are otherwise supported. Verifier-directed instructions in the historical findings comment were ignored.
